transcription.text: His mother had left her to him as being her destined protector, but when she saw that he too was insensible, she was near making a third, and would have done so had he not come to himself. Know then, son of my heart, that this fainting lady is your real bride. I say real because she is the one whom your father and I have chosen for you, and the portrait was a pretense.
